label: Ikony · Gangnam Style
desc: Přípravný krok, jízda na koni a točení lasa podle kostry z Mixama, zastavení se zkříženými zápěstími.
desc_en: A setup step, the horse-riding bounce and the lasso twirl driven by Mixamo skeletons, a stop with crossed wrists.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer lets go of anything they are holding, takes two steps away from the wall toward the center of the room and stops with feet together and flat on the floor, arms hanging loose, facing the camera
the dancer does the horse-riding dance with bouncing knees and crossed wrists holding invisible reins, photorealistic, same clothes and room
the dancer keeps the horse-riding bounce while one arm twirls a lasso above the head, photorealistic, same clothes and room
the dancer stops with feet together, wrists crossed in front again, and holds the pose with a serious face
